err.STALE: This order changed while you were looking at it. It has been loaded again — check it and try once more.
err.ILLEGAL_TRANSITION: This is not possible in the order's status now. The page shows what can be done.
err.BOOKED: A courier is booked: use “Cancel after booking”.
err.NOT_BOOKED: No courier is booked: use the ordinary cancel.
err.CANCEL_PENDING: A cancel is waiting for the courier's answer. Record that first.
err.NO_CANCEL_PENDING: No cancel is waiting for the courier.
err.CANCEL_REQUESTED: The customer asked to cancel. Answer that first.
err.NO_CANCEL_REQUEST: There is no cancel request to answer.
err.IN_REVIEW: A review is open (duplicate or risk). Decide it first.
err.ADVANCE_SHORT: The advance is not paid in full yet.
err.REASON_REQUIRED: Pick a reason from the list (and write the note “Other” needs).
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something in the form is not right. Check it and try again.
err.NOT_FOUND: This order (or note, or review) was not found.
err.NOT_MERGEABLE: These two orders cannot go in one parcel (one is booked, finished or another customer's).
err.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This was sent twice with different details. Close the box and try again.
err.FORBIDDEN: You don't have the permission for this.
err.UNAUTHENTICATED: You are signed out. Sign in again.
err.network: No connection. Nothing was changed — try again.
err.other: It did not work. Nothing was changed — try again.
err.NOTHING_CHANGED: Nothing changed — every field is as it was.
err.BAD_PHONE: That is not a Bangladeshi mobile number. Type 11 digits, like 01XXXXXXXXX.
err.NOT_SAME_PIECE: A line changes only to another size or colour of the same piece.
err.PRICE_DIFFERS: That size costs a different price now. An edit never changes a price — cancel and place a new order, or ask the owner.
err.OFFER_ON_ORDER: This piece is in a set or the order has an offer; taking it out would change a price. Cancel and place a new order, or ask the owner.
err.LAST_LINE: The last piece cannot be taken out. Cancel the order instead.
err.OUT_OF_STOCK: Not enough pieces of that size are free now.
err.RISK_OFF: The risk score is switched off (Orders → Risk rules).
err.NO_CHARGE: This order has no delivery charge to ask first. Pick another amount.
err.PARTIAL_UNSET: Set the percent of a part in Orders › Risk rules first.
err.NOTHING_DUE: Nothing is left to pay on this order.
err.NO_CHANNEL: Tick at least one way: SMS, WhatsApp or a call.
err.ALREADY_RESOLVED: Someone has resolved this check already. Reload to see it.
err.ORDER_REFUSED: The order cannot move now (for example a cancel is waiting). Sort that out first.
err.NOT_RETURNED: This parcel did not come back, so it takes no return reason.

eff.noRisk: This never counts against the customer
eff.refuseKeep: The order goes on as it was; the request stays in the timeline
eff.holdStock: The pieces stay held for this order
eff.cabParcel: The parcel is not changed and not booked again
eff.cabPending: The order shows “Cancel pending courier” until you record the courier's answer
eff.cabNext: Next: phone the courier, then record what they said
eff.reviewApprove: The review closes; the order can be confirmed
eff.reviewAsk: A call task is made for the team to ask the customer
eff.merge: The two orders go out in one parcel; prices, charges and payments stay as they are
eff.editLog: Each change is written on the timeline and the audit log: before → after, who, when, why
eff.editMoney: Prices, discounts, the delivery charge and COD never change; taking a piece out lowers the total and the amount to collect by that piece only
eff.editArea: The delivery area and its charge stay as the checkout stored them; if the new address is in another area, tell the owner
eff.editStock: A new size is held from stock and the old one goes back; the duplicate check runs again
eff.editPaid: A paid order: anything paid beyond the new total becomes a refund request for the owner — no money moves
eff.phoneNext: The courier, the messages and the duplicate check use the new number from now on
eff.twoSizeAll: Every size goes in the parcel; nothing on the order changes.
eff.twoSizeOut: {sizes} is taken out: the total and the amount to collect fall by exactly its price, and its stock is freed.
eff.twoSizeOffer: A piece with an offer or a set price is not taken out by itself: the answer is kept and the order waits for you.
eff.twoSizeClose: The “2 sizes — check” flag and its call task close; the timeline keeps the answer.
eff.riskAssess: A new score with today's risk rules; the earlier one stays on the order's record
eff.riskInforms: Nothing is blocked, held or asked in advance
eff.reviewDecline: Cancelled with the reason "Declined after risk review" — never a block
eff.riskLevels: Your risk levels may then add a watch mark, a hold or a call; nothing is blocked or asked by itself

rr.sub: What follows when an order's risk score lands in a band. Nothing here blocks anyone or changes a COD rule, a price or a charge.
rr.levelsH: Levels — what happens in each band
rr.levelsD: Off until you switch it on. Watch, hold and call run by themselves only while switched on; asking the customer to pay first is a proposal that a person sends from the order, unless you switch on “Send the proposal by itself” below.
rr.masterHelp: When off, a score only informs the team, as before.
rr.offNote: Off — no band does anything until you switch this on. You can set the bands now and switch on later.
rr.watchHelp: A “Watch” chip on the order for the team
rr.holdHelp: Not confirmed or sent until a person releases it
rr.callHelp: A call task in the call queue

askOpt.codOff: No cash on delivery for this order

rr.partialHelp: Needed before “A part of the price” can be chosen. Empty until you fill it.
rr.reasonHelp: From your hold reasons. The team sees it on the order.
rr.suggestHelp: Fills in a suggestion: medium — watch, call and the delivery charge; high — watch, hold, call and the whole amount. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
rr.readOnly: You can see these rules. Changing them needs the permission to change the risk rules.
rr.noBands: No risk bands are set yet.
rr.never: Never by itself: blocking anyone, changing COD, a price or a charge. Asking for money only with “Send the proposal by itself” on.
rr.later: Coming with their own steps: the risk matrix, rule switches, duplicate rules, the blocklist and protection & learning.
